content.text: The IP provisions are all customer-favorable; no assignment of our IP/data to Vendor and no joint ownership.

input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.
input.rationale: The Agreement already meets our preferred position. §14.2 vests ownership of each Deliverable in Customer upon creation with an express present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurance cooperation. §14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and pre-existing/independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right to provide, secure, support and improve the Services for Customer; §15.1 reinforces this by barring sale, advertising use, data commingling and model training without our written consent. §14.3 lets Vendor retain only Vendor Technology (defined in §1.8 to exclude Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP) and channels embedded Vendor Technology into the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works, extended to Affiliates and contractors, with identification and no-restrictive-third-party-material duties. §14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument and preserves our unrestricted right to use our own feedback. The remaining wrinkles are within our bargaining range and not worth a redline: ownership is conditioned on payment of the applicable Fees (consistent with §10.2's delivery-on-payment mechanic), "Deliverable" is limited to work product an Order Form identifies as created specifically for Customer (curable at Order Form drafting), and the Customer Data definition carves out anonymized telemetry that cannot reasonably be linked to us or an individual. Nothing assigns our IP or data to Vendor and no deliverable is owned by Vendor without a licence back, so no walk-away or fallback issue arises.
